findings: TestResponseMemory does not implement the exact unsafe ResponseMemory signatures, omits physical ownership and verification Claim binding, and does not establish the backing extent or consuming release lifetime.
The adapter calls nonexistent Call::from_response and Mailbox test_* methods, misuses nongeneric Worker/open_worker and conflicts with the production Result alias.
Inner module documentation is appended after existing items, and std::sync::Arc has no reviewed kernel/no_std allocator integration.
Rows and negative categories are declarations only; no runner iterates them, production clock and second-CAS controls are absent, and wake=None coverage is incomplete.
Tests use substring checks and a tautological self-hash assertion; the generator records rather than enforces pinned stager/template identities and lacks exact adapter-only output-diff proof.

Add reviewed private test helpers that construct actual Mailbox/Call/Worker state and invoke unchanged admission, return, cancellation and publication paths.
Supply an executable row/negative runner and exact parser with deterministic production clock and CAS hooks.
Replace structural tests with independent pinned membership/hash, input-preservation, exact output-diff and mutation controls.
